caption:
Allah does not charge a soul except with that within its capacity. "Our Lord, do not impose blame upon us if we have forgotten or erred... You are our protector, so give us victory over the disbelieving people."

Surah Al-Baqarah (2:286), the last of the last three ayat of the surah. Swipe through for the Arabic, then English, Mandarin, Korean, Japanese and Malay renderings.

Sources on the final slide.

sourcing.primary_text: Qur'an, Surah Al-Baqarah (2), Ayah 286 - the last of 'the last three ayat of Al-Baqarah' (2:284-286), posted as its own ayah per the channel's one-post-per-distinct-verse rule. Unlike a discretionary 'ayah of the day' pick, this specific ayah could not be swapped out for an easier-to-source alternative, since the user explicitly asked for these exact three ayat by name.
sourcing.arabic: Uthmani script (edition quran-uthmani), api.alquran.cloud. Live-fetched and verified this session (2026-09-18) via GET /v1/ayah/2:286/editions/quran-uthmani,en.sahih,zh.jian,ko.korean,ja.japanese,ms.basmeih, HTTP 200.
sourcing.english: Saheeh International (edition en.sahih), api.alquran.cloud. Same live call as above, quoted verbatim including the translator's own bracketed interpolations.
sourcing.chinese: Ma Jian, 马坚 (edition zh.jian), api.alquran.cloud. Same live call as above, rendered verbatim with no corrections needed.
sourcing.malay: Abdullah Muhammad Basmeih (edition ms.basmeih), api.alquran.cloud. Same live call as above, rendered verbatim including the translator's own parenthetical interpolations.
sourcing.japanese: Edition ja.japanese, api.alquran.cloud. Translator is listed as 'Unknown' in the source's own metadata, cited on-slide as 'translator not specified by source'. Same live call as above, rendered verbatim with no corrections needed.
sourcing.korean: IMPORTANT DEVIATION FROM THIS CHANNEL'S NORMAL KOREAN SOURCING, fully disclosed: the ko.korean edition of api.alquran.cloud returned only a 3-syllable fragment ('대가를') for this specific ayah/edition pair in the same live call referenced above (confirmed twice this session, re-fetched fresh both times to rule out a display-truncation artifact rather than a genuine source-data gap - this exact gap for this exact ayah was already documented once before, in quran-65-3.meta.json's candidate_selection_note, which led to 2:286 being swapped for a different ayah that day). This time 2:286 cannot be swapped out, since the user explicitly asked for 'the last 3 ayat from Surah Al-Baqarah' by name. Per the channel's hard rule of never completing or paraphrasing missing scripture from memory, the Korean slide below is NOT sourced from the ko.korean edition at all. It is my own careful, transparently-labelled translation, produced directly from the verified Arabic (quran-uthmani) and English (Saheeh International) text above - the exact same honest-fallback approach this channel already uses whenever hadith-api has no Korean/Chinese/Japanese/Malay edition for a given hadith (see nawawi-13.meta.json, nawawi-15.meta.json). The on-slide note reads 'Claude's own translation (source edition incomplete for this ayah)' rather than crediting a translator or scholar who did not produce this text.
sourcing.verification_note: Arabic, English, Chinese, Japanese and Malay came from a single live api.alquran.cloud request made this session (2026-09-18): GET https://api.alquran.cloud/v1/ayah/2:286/editions/quran-uthmani,en.sahih,zh.jian,ko.korean,ja.japanese,ms.basmeih, HTTP 200. Korean is a transparently labelled own-translation, not sourced from that edition, for the reason given above. See channels.json's ig-blankdiscussions._niche_note for why honest sourcing is a hard requirement for this channel.
sourcing.compliance_check: Manually checked against scripts/data/compliance-policy.json's halal keyword-blocklists (intoxicants, pork, gambling, riba, immodesty, profanity, superstition, origins_patterns, animate_imagery, context_review). No blocklisted terms present in any of the six language texts; no imagery generated at all. Content is a supplication (du'a) for mercy and forgiveness - no context_review flags apply. Clean.
